LESSON: WRITING 9.5.1 CREATIVE WRITING: NARRATIVE COMPOSITIONS (240-280 WORDS)

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.5: Writing 9.5.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions (240-280 words)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 9.5.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions (240-280 words), part of Strand 9 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: where necessary. ● Let the learners publish their work by either: 1. Why do we enjoy reading stories? 2. How can you make your composition interesting?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 9.5.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions (240-280 words) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and Imagination –making observations enhances the learner’s creativity as they create narrative compositions on a

variety of topics

● Digital literacy – interacting with digital technology is enhanced as the learner shares their work via email and on social

media

Values:
Unity is promoted as the learner cooperates with peers to revise and make their work better

Link to other subjects:

● Kiswahili, French, German, Arabic and Chinese: Narrative composition writing is learnt and practised in all these languages.

● Performing Arts also promote creativity
